title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: employee removal notice, reinstatement fee basis, and re-enrollment cooldown by tier
content:
This document covers the Corporate Wellness Partnership's notice given to an employee before their enrollment is removed from the employer's roster, the tier's reinstatement fee basis for bringing a suspended enrollment back current, whether a removed employee may re-enroll later, and the cooldown period before they may do so.

| Tier | Notice before employee removal | Reinstatement fee (tier basis) | Re-enrollment allowed after removal | Re-enrollment cooldown |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Startup Partner | 7 calendar days | $25.00 | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Small Business Partner | 7 calendar days | $25.00 | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Mid-Market Partner | 10 calendar days | $0.00 | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Enterprise Partner | 14 calendar days | $0.00 | Yes | 15 calendar days |
| Municipal Partner | 14 calendar days | $0.00 | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Nonprofit Partner | 10 calendar days | $0.00 | Yes | 30 calendar days |

The reinstatement fee amount shown here is the tier's basis for that fee; the current basis for whether and how much of that fee is actually billed is stated in a separate document. Where re-enrollment is allowed after removal, the cooldown is the minimum period that must elapse before the employee may re-enroll; the basis for counting that period, and the point from which it runs, is stated in a separate document.
